mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, rule_version_id, record_no, order_id, order_no, order_amount, order_user_id, order_user_name, agent_id, agent_user_id, agent_name, agent_level, commission_level, commission_rate, commission_amount, bonus_type, status, settle_time, cancel_reason, remark, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dms_commission_record WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM dms_commission_record WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY commission_level ASC
SELECT FROM dms_commission_record WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} ORDER BY commission_level ASC
SELECT FROM dms_commission_record ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM dms_commission_record WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM dms_commission_record WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM dms_commission_record WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND status = #{status} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT r.* FROM dms_commission_record r INNER JOIN ( SELECT id, status, receive_time FROM dms_shop_order ) o ON o.id = r.order_id WHERE r.status = 0 AND r.commission_amount > 0 AND o.status = 3 AND o.receive_time IS NOT NULL AND o.receive_time <= #{receivedCutoff} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_after_sale a WHERE a.order_id = r.order_id AND a.status IN (0, 4, 5, 6) ) ORDER BY o.receive_time, r.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(commission_amount), 0) FROM dms_commission_record WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND status = 0
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(commission_amount), 0) FROM dms_commission_record WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dms_commission_record (tenant_id, rule_version_id, record_no, order_id, order_no, order_amount, order_user_id, order_user_name, agent_id, agent_user_id, agent_name, agent_level, commission_level, commission_rate, commission_amount, bonus_type, status, remark) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{ruleVersionId}, #{recordNo}, #{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{orderAmount}, #{orderUserId}, #{orderUserName}, #{agentId}, #{agentUserId}, #{agentName}, #{agentLevel}, #{commissionLevel}, #{commissionRate}, #{commissionAmount}, #{bonusType}, #{status}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_commission_record SET commission_amount = #{commissionAmount}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
